item.description:
**Fixes for review and the tucked chat.**
- If Review can't start, the chat's message box now says why. - Reviewing the second of two pages keeps the chat tucked behind that page. - Esc goes to a terminal again during a review, so Esc reaches Claude in the drawer and vim in another tab. - Marks you make after scrolling far down the page become their own notes. - A new review never waits on an earlier one whose message wasn't confirmed. - ⌘⇧↩ tucks a chat only beside a page it shared. Beside any other page it zooms, as before. - A page you opened yourself no longer adds "About …" to that chat's messages. - Clicking a Markdown, image or video page focuses it again.
